title: Fasmora 3.2610.5254 is available
message: This update fixes Web App uploads and OAuth popup sign-in, and refines Incognito browsing, tab previews, voice chat, and Passwords access.
whatsNew: Fixed file type filtering and single-file selection when uploading through Web Apps.
Fixed OAuth sign-in popups that stayed blank after authorization completed.
Matched Incognito menus and browser bars to the Incognito theme.
Made tab previews larger and clearer.
Added a launcher shortcut to Fasmora Passwords.
